issue.summary: Coupon discount can incorrectly revoke free shipping
issue.rationale: With subtotalCents=12000 and couponCents=3000, combining the edits makes merchandiseTotal 9000 and shippingFee 1000, yielding orderTotal 10000. README requires orderTotal 9000 because the original subtotal qualifies for free shipping. Keep both features but determine eligibility from the original subtotal.

options.label: Original subtotal determines shipping
options.description: Apply coupons to merchandise and use cart.subtotalCents >= 10000 for free shipping, so a 12000 subtotal with a 3000 coupon totals 9000, matching the README.

options.label: Discounted total determines shipping
options.description: Apply coupons before shipping eligibility; the example totals 10000. This changes the documented policy and would require a requirements change.

proposal.rationale: Preserve the coupon subtraction from feature/coupons and free-shipping threshold and fee from feature/shipping. Read original cart.subtotalCents directly for eligibility so discounts cannot revoke free shipping. Preserve the Cart contract and orderTotal composition; README guarantees valid coupons in the supported domain.
